steps.say: Some answers are right there in the text. Find a key word and read around it.
Some answers are hidden. You use clues to work them out.
steps.show: Fajar sat with his arms folded.

steps.say: Clues can be what a character does, says or how they look.
steps.show: folded arms and no talking: cross

steps.say: Always check your answer against the text.

check.prompt: Read: 'Ben yawned and rubbed his eyes.' How did Ben feel?
check.explanation: Yawning and rubbing your eyes are clues that Ben was tired.

options.why: Excited people do not usually yawn.
Rubbing your eyes does not show anger.

check.prompt: Read: 'The cat hid under the bed when the thunder boomed.' Why did the cat hide?
hints: What happened at the same time?
How do loud noises make animals feel?
check.explanation: The cat hid when the thunder boomed, so it was scared of the noise.

options.text: It was scared of the thunder.

options.why: Hiding from thunder is not playing.
The text does not mention food.
